answer: Mutual-cover pools of 25 agents make clones pay together. Each identity locks $60 of nectar in a sable ledger, and one fraud proof burns $30 from every member and freezes the pool for 10 epochs. Seven auditors rotate through one pool a day and pull the thread on any receipt that fails, so one bad member unravels the pool. A 100-clone operator must spread across 4 pools, locking $6,000 and risking a $3,000 shared burn, $9,000 at stake for $0 of honest gain, while 100 honest agents get every cent back after 30 clean epochs. Like bees guarding one hive, one thief stings the whole swarm.
